title: Article 86 — Right of President to address and send messages to Houses

content.overview: Article 86 entitles the President to address either House or both Houses assembled together, and to send messages to either House (whether with respect to a Bill then pending or otherwise). The House to which a message is sent shall with all convenient despatch consider any matter required by the message to be taken into consideration.
content.glance: President may address either/both Houses and send messages; House must consider matters required by the message.
content.study:
Article 86:
(1) The President may address either House of Parliament or both Houses assembled together, and for that purpose require the attendance of members.
(2) The President may send messages to either House of Parliament, whether with respect to a Bill then pending in Parliament or otherwise, and a House to which any message is so sent shall with all convenient despatch consider any matter required by the message to be taken into consideration.

Related: Article 87 (special address at the commencement of the first session after each general election to the Lok Sabha and at the commencement of the first session of each year).

Examination: address power; message power; duty of the House to consider.

sections.heading: Powers
sections.body:
1. Address either House or both Houses assembled together (may require attendance).
2. Send messages to either House (Bill-related or otherwise).
3. House must consider with all convenient despatch any matter required by the message.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Explain Article 86.
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 86 entitles the President to address either House of Parliament or both Houses assembled together, and to send messages to either House whether with respect to a pending Bill or otherwise. The House receiving a message shall with all convenient despatch consider any matter required by the message to be taken into consideration.

examTips: Address + messages; House must consider. Link Art 87 special address.

keyTakeaways: Art 86: President may address Houses and send messages; House must consider.
